open_points.subject: authenticate_staff
open_points.text: - authenticate_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction by beginning a transaction on the store through PortalStore.begin, which returns a PortalTransaction, with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach account and session persistence only through the staff_access repository PortalTransaction.staff_access returns, append its audit only through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once: the outcome commits once, and a failure rolls back with PortalTransaction.rollback only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted method references, including PortalTransaction.rollback, with classified prose describing use of the transaction's declared repository, commit, and rollback operations without point navigation.

open_points.subject: create_staff_account
open_points.text: - create_staff_account: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST complete its authorization check before it opens a transaction, never while one is open, because that check opens a transaction of its own and a second one nested inside this transaction is forbidden. It MUST then open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach staff account, session and assignment persistence only through the staff_access repository PortalTransaction.staff_access returns, append its audit only through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once: a successful write commits once, a failure rolls back with PortalTransaction.rollback only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
open_points.rule:
Нота остаётся требованием к
поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый
микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted method references, including PortalTransaction.rollback, with classified prose describing use of the transaction's declared repository, commit, and rollback operations without point navigation.

open_points.subject: resolve_staff_session
open_points.text: - resolve_staff_session: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, and read only through the staff_access repository PortalTransaction.staff_access returns: first the persisted session addressed by the identifier parsed out of the token, then, only when that session exists, the staff account that session names. It MUST roll the transaction back with PortalTransaction.rollback exactly once immediately after those reads and mark the local open flag closed before it evaluates revocation, expiry or account status, so that a decidable rejection is never answered as a storage failure. It MUST use no legacy transaction-level staff method and append no audit.
open_points.rule:

микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: Replace the dotted method references, including PortalTransaction.rollback, with classified prose referring to the transaction's declared staff-access and rollback operations without point navigation.

open_points.text: - sign_out_staff: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open its transaction with an explicit assignment, never as a context manager, reach session persistence only through the staff_access repository PortalTransaction.staff_access returns, append its audit only through the audit repository PortalTransaction.audit returns, use no legacy transaction-level staff method, and close the transaction exactly once: the revocation commits once, and a failure rolls back with PortalTransaction.rollback only while the local open flag still marks the transaction open and re-raises the original failure unchanged.
